messages:
ivy: Day 1 q: where should I drop setup issues vs product/team questions? Also drowning in CI pings.

kevin_it: Welcome! Quick map:
- Hardware/VPN/SSH/access -> #help (infra) or DM IT for urgent
- HR/payroll/badge -> DM @sandra_peopleops or use the People Ops portal (link pinned)
- Product/code/design -> your team channel (e.g., #eng, #product)
- General newbie Qs -> keep in #new-hires so others can find answers later

ivy: How do I silence CI noise but still get pages for failures?

kevin_it: Two options:
1) Channel mute: channel header -> Notifications -> Mute (silences chatter, keeps mentions)
2) Bot-level: open the CI bot's setup message and run `/ci-bot unsubscribe` or `/ci-bot settings critical-only` so you only get pages. Example:
```
/ci-bot settings alerts=critical
```

ci-bot: Subscription update: ivy set alerts=critical-only.

oliver: Threading etiquette: always reply in-thread for follow-ups on the same issue. Start a new message if it's a different problem. Use a short header like `Help: VPN auth 401 (steps tried)` so people can skim. React with :white_check_mark: when resolved.

sandra_peopleops: For intros, drop `Name | Team | TZ | Pronouns | 1-line focus | Fun fact` in #introductions. For badge/equipment DM me full name + shipping address.

ivy: Thanks! That helps a lot — I'll unsubscribe from noisy bots and post my intro. :tada:
